# Model card: Debrief summary

| | |
|---|---|
| Purpose | Summarise a stage's scorecards for the hiring manager: criteria, disagreements, open questions, recommendations. |
| Workflow | hire |
| Code | `pairly_hire.interviewing.debrief` |
| Prompt | `hire_debrief_summary` version `v1`, file SHA-256 `a6dd44d5bb0a44fb...` |
| Output schema | `DebriefDraft` |
| Model tiers, cheapest first | `small` (anthropic `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001`, openai `gpt-6-luna`) then `large` (anthropic `claude-sonnet-5-5`, openai `gpt-6.1-sol`) |
| Temperature | 0.0 |
| Output token limit | 1500 |
| Confidence threshold to accept | none |

## Inputs

The job title, the stage, the criteria and their ratings, and per interviewer a label, the recommendation and the notes. Never a name; while the candidate is blind the notes are redacted first.

## Outputs

A `DebriefDraft`: summary, per criterion notes, disagreements, open questions. The numbers (means, spread, disagreements) are computed in code, never by the model.

## Human oversight

The hiring manager decides advance, hold or reject with a reason (`decide`, second factor), recorded as a decision record. The summary moves nothing.

## Limits

* Only as good as the notes interviewers wrote.
* A refused or failed draft falls back to a template built from the numbers.
* Every call is logged in `model_calls` (prompt version and hash, model, inputs, output, tokens, cost) and fails closed: no model means a person does the step.

## Evals

Numbers come only from result files committed in `evals/results/`, exactly as written there. See [evals.md](../evals.md) for what each run measures. In the gated files (`hire.json`, `pay.json`) a model metric stays pending until thresholds are set for it; live numbers are read from the `*_live.json` files, which do not gate.

Structural checks only (`python -m evals.structural`), on the committed recordings: scripted answers, not model output. They say whether every recorded output fits the schema, holds no banned content or em dash, passes the component's own deterministic check and points only at its input. They are not quality judgments: how good a draft is needs a live model and people.
